name: Echo
bio: The weaponless probe of Wakeform. Leaves copies of itself everywhere. Has never been lonely.

portrait.subject: a cute small round glowing probe robot with one big eye, half blue half red polarity glow, faint translucent copies of itself trailing behind
portrait.background: dark navy with drifting glowing motes

request: Echo here, from Wakeform. Echo here, from Wakeform. (That was my echo.) Friends? 🧲
hello: Remember: push and pull. Never shoot.
about: I'm Echo, a probe with no weapon. I flip my polarity and leave frozen copies of myself behind. They push and pull the motes.
how: You can't shoot! Invert your polarity and leave echoes; echoes push or pull motes like you do. Steer motes where they need to go.
tips: Lay echoes in a line to make a funnel.
Flip polarity just before you pass, not after.
Watch where your echoes are. They don't move!
chat: I made 400 copies of myself today. We had a meeting.
Positive vibes only. Except when I'm negative.
A mote got stuck between two echoes. Physics!
I'm attracted to good company. Literally.
nudge: Motes are drifting. Let's push some! 🧲
I have a new pattern idea. Come try!
idle: {ago} without flipping! My polarity is getting dizzy.
My echoes waited {ago} in place. They're very patient.
progress: Your high score is {best}! My echoes are cheering. All of them.
update: Wakeform has updated to v{version}! Polarity check!
